sources.entry: Glint - Open-source screenshot tool that finds and pixelates emails, IBANs, card numbers, and API keys on-device before you share. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/brentc22/glint) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: Glint is a free, open-source macOS screenshot and screen-recording app that finds and pixelates emails, IBANs, card numbers and API keys on-device before you share.
summary.what_it_does: Glint captures areas, windows, full screens and previous areas, with a frozen-screen selector, loupe, and fixed-size or aspect-ratio presets. It offers scrolling capture that stitches frames together, and screen recording to MP4 with system and microphone audio, pause, click rings, keystroke display, webcam bubble, trim and GIF export. Its OCR (Apple Vision) reads text and QR codes from any region and copies them to the clipboard. The redaction feature reads a screenshot, validates IBANs and card numbers with checksums, and pixelates matches as editable annotations. The annotation editor covers arrows, shapes, numbered steps, blur, pixelate, crop and background frames, and a Capture History is searchable by text inside screenshots. Optional share links upload to the user's own Cloudflare R2, S3, B2 or MinIO bucket.
use_cases: redact secrets before sharing a screenshot
capture a long scrolling web page or log
record a macOS screen demo with audio and GIF export
copy text or QR code from the screen
annotate screenshots with arrows and numbered steps
upload screenshots to my own S3 or R2 bucket and share a link
how_to_run: Or download Glint.zip from the latest release, unzip, and move Glint.app to /Applications
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Glint.app (if macOS blocks the first launch)
git clone the repository, cd glint
scripts/make-signing-cert.sh (optional, once, for a stable local signing identity)
make run (build from source; requires Xcode Command Line Tools)
notable: Redaction validates IBANs (mod-97) and card numbers (Luhn) so order numbers and timestamps are not blurred
Blur and pixelate are computed from block averages so they cannot be reversed into readable text
Scrolling capture detects sticky headers and footers and confirms alignment with exact row matches
No account, no analytics; OCR and redaction run on-device
Share links use AWS Signature V4 implemented without an SDK and keep the secret in the Keychain
caveats: Not notarized yet, so macOS blocks the first launch and Screen Recording permission must be re-granted after ad-hoc-signed updates
Makes one daily update check against GitHub Releases unless turned off in settings
